decision.observation: 7:10 pm, Sat. 6; after the C press the bobber is airborne above the rod (~0.61,0.14), so the dip again only reeled in. The pond is directly south.
decision.hypothesis: Recasting will put the bobber back in the pond; catches today (Joja Cola x2) came right after a dip cue, so continuing this loop at the same spot may land another catch.
decision.memory: Fishing loop: face water, hold C to cast, press C at the bobber dip; if the bar minigame opens, hold/release LMB to keep the green bar on the fish. Catches: Sunfish (day 5), Joja Cola x2 (day 6).
